summary_en.motivation: To quantify the uncertainty in aeroacoustic noise from rotating blades.
summary_en.method: An uncertainty quantification framework is applied in the time domain to rotating blade aeroacoustics.
summary_en.result: The method provides probabilistic estimates of noise radiation.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using simulation case studies.

papers.title: PENDEKATAN KETERAMPILAN PROSES DALAM MENINGKATKAN HASIL BELAJAR BAHASA INDONESIA
papers.abstract: This research is a classroom action research. This research was carried out at Ma’arif MakassarVocational School. This study involved class X students with a total of 30 students. the purposeof this study was to improve the learning outcomes of Indonesian language for students of classX Ma’arif Makassar Vocational High School. This study uses 2 cycles with each one cycle of 3meetings. Based on the implementation of learning and discussion of the influence of theprocess skills approach in class X. So the authors can conclude that efforts to improve learningoutcomes and student involvement in the learning process in Indonesian subjects can be donewith active learning. The results of this study prove that the process skills approach is able toincrease student activity and involvement in the learning process and also improve studentlearning outcomes.
papers.venue: Pedagogik Journal of Islamic Elementary School

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是印尼语教学中的过程技能方法，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about educational pedagogy in Indonesian language learning, with no mention of FEA, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or any engineering or biomedical design context.

summary_zh.method: 课堂行动研究，两周期教学
summary_zh.result: 过程技能方法提升学生参与度和成绩

summary_en.motivation: To improve Indonesian language learning outcomes through active learning.
summary_en.method: Classroom action research with two cycles of process skills approach.
summary_en.result: The process skills approach increased student activity and learning outcomes.
